India to Implement Ethanol Blending in Petrol, Government Seeks Public Feedback

The Indian government has announced plans to implement ethanol blending in petrol, with the goal of reducing dependence on imported oil. The move aims to promote domestic production and reduce greenhouse gas emissions. However, critics argue that the plan may lead to increased costs for consumers. The government is seeking public feedback on the proposal.
